content.value_statement: HTTP 402 payment flows are hard to inspect and assemble safely. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code plan custody-free x402 payments and monetize APIs.
actual_capabilities: Explains x402 402 challenges in terms of price, token, recipient, expiry, and network.
Builds unsigned EIP-3009 typed data for payer wallet signing.
Assembles an X-PAYMENT header after a user supplies a signature.
Plans facilitator actions for supported, verify, and settle operations.
Generates PaymentRequirements for APIs that return paid HTTP 402 responses.
limitations: Does not custody keys or sign payments for the user.
Focuses on USDC on Base and Base Sepolia unless full token requirements are supplied.
Requires an external wallet or signer to approve typed data.
Facilitator behavior depends on the chosen service and network availability.

use_cases.title: Pay a Protected API
use_cases.description: Decode a 402 response, prepare signing data, and assemble the payment header for a paid retry.

use_cases.title: Monetize an Endpoint
use_cases.description: Create payment requirements that describe price, token, recipient, network, and accepted settlement terms.

use_cases.title: Review Agent Payments
use_cases.description: Inspect payment details before a human or wallet signs any authorization.

prompt_templates.title: Decode a Payment Challenge
prompt_templates.prompt: Use x402 to explain this 402 response in plain terms: [paste response]. Include amount, token, recipient, expiry, and network.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a payment request

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Payment Header
prompt_templates.prompt: Build the unsigned x402 payment data for this requirement: [paste requirement]. Use payer [wallet address] and show what must be signed.

prompt_templates.title: Create API Payment Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: Create x402 payment requirements for an endpoint that charges [amount] USDC on Base to [recipient address].

prompt_templates.title: Design a Paid Request Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an end-to-end x402 flow for [service]. Include challenge review, signing, header creation, facilitator verification, and settlement checks.

output_examples.input: A 402 challenge for 0.01 USDC on Base.
output_examples.output: The skill explains the requested price, payee, token, network, expiry, and next signing step.

output_examples.input: A request to monetize an API endpoint.
output_examples.output: The skill describes payment requirements the server can return with HTTP 402.

output_examples.input: A signed payment authorization from a wallet.
output_examples.output: The skill helps assemble the X-PAYMENT header for the paid retry.

best_practices: Decode and review every challenge before asking a wallet to sign.
Confirm payee, amount, token, network, and expiry outside the payment header.
Use Base Sepolia for testing before sending real USDC on Base.
anti_patterns: Asking the skill to sign transactions or manage private keys.
Paying a 402 challenge without checking recipient and amount.
Assuming every facilitator supports every network, asset, or endpoint.

faq.question: What is x402?
faq.answer: x402 uses HTTP 402 responses to request payment before a protected resource is served.

faq.question: Does this skill hold private keys?
faq.answer: No. It prepares payment data and headers, but signing must happen in an external wallet.

faq.question: Which networks does it focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on USDC on Base and Base Sepolia, with support for full custom payment requirements.

faq.question: Can it help monetize my API?
faq.answer: Yes. It can generate PaymentRequirements for an endpoint that returns HTTP 402.

faq.question: Does it make payments automatically?
faq.answer: No. A user or wallet must approve and sign the authorization before payment can proceed.

faq.question: What should I verify before signing?
faq.answer: Verify the recipient, amount, token, network, expiry, and facilitator before signing any authorization.
